text:
Situation: Bacteriostatic water has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-12-03 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 59 months. Corvale East holds 40 units at 3.6 per day (11 days on hand). Corvale General holds 83 units at 4.2 per day (20 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2021-12-03. The product label names Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited (FEI 3008316085) as a registered plant. FDA inspection 1106244 at that plant ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25, 819 days before the shortage posting. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2020-03-25, 618 days before the posting. The label also names Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) as a registered plant, which received an OAI classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 590 days before the posting.

Our position: Current inventory covers 11 to 20 days at present usage. The rule‑ranked alternate manufacturer Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd. is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Fujian Genohope Biotech Ltd.; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate purchase from HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate purchase from ProPharma Distribution; requires buyer approval.
4. Pharmacist to verify use of Sterile Water 1 mL/mL from Nephron Pharmaceuticals Corporation as an alternate concentration or vial size; requires pharmacist approval.

Not recommended: No additional sourcing or clinical changes at this time.
